title: Top coefficient of a sign restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ map sign vectors of length $n$ to signs, and let $J$ be a set of coordinates among the first $n$ coordinates. The top coefficient of the restriction of $f$ to $J$, with all coordinates outside $J$ fixed to $+1$, is the average over all sign assignments $y$ on $J$ of the value of $f$ at that extended assignment multiplied by the product of the signs assigned by $y$ to every coordinate in $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps sign vectors of length $n$ to signs
$J$ is a finite set of coordinates among the first $n$ coordinates
